approval.scope: Initial scale/MIDI/uncertainty/range rules approved, with broad exotic-scale support requested

scope: Causal source tracking and three target decisions only; unchanged original lead; no harmony synthesis, lead tuning or automatic key detection

scale_policy.temperament: 12-tone equal temperament only; named traditional sets are approximations, not full raga/maqam or microtonal systems
scale_policy.custom: 12 independently editable root-relative pitch classes; empty set disables all scale targets
scale_policy.offsets: Three signed zero-based degree displacements plus independent signed octave offsets
scale_policy.accidentals: Nearest scale anchor; exact ties downward; source deviation remains continuous in the harmony targets
scale_policy.expression: Target = measured continuous source MIDI + scale interval. No correction of original lead or snapping away bends/vibrato
scale_policy.engineering_hysteresis: Retain anchor until another is 0.30 semitone closer; 15-cent band on either side of midpoint; no extra dwell or F0 smoothing

midi_policy.targets: Absolute held MIDI pitches; no input MIDI pitch-bend/aftertouch mapping in PR03
midi_policy.allocation: Newest three distinct sounding pitches; surviving pitches retain slots; newest unassigned pitches fill lowest free slots. Older held pitches return when slots free
midi_policy.duplicates: Count repeated note-ons per channel/pitch; one note-off releases one count; same pitch on multiple channels occupies one slot
midi_policy.sustain: Per-channel CC64; CC120 kills channel immediately, CC123 releases keys respecting sustain, CC121 releases pedal but not physical keys; velocity-zero note-on is note-off
midi_policy.ordering: Host buffer order at equal sample offsets; events applied before that sample's analysis
midi_policy.overflow: 4096 musical events per callback, independent of 64 diagnostic records; invalid offsets, event or counter overflow clear notes and mark MIDI unknown until processor/system reset. Safety ceiling is intentionally not partition invariant

uncertainty: Unvoiced/uncertain source disables all pitched targets; lead is unchanged; no hold-last-target through uncertainty
range: Disable each target requiring a shift outside inclusive +/-24 semitones; do not clamp; MIDI source bends may move a target in/out of range
reset: Reset, source/tracker change, state recall, bypass transition, transport stop/backward/discontinuity clear tracker history and transient MIDI. Silence clears source anchor, not physically held MIDI
engineering_constants: Tracker windows/thresholds and hysteresis magnitude are versioned engineering choices, not perceptually qualified values
remaining_gates: Frozen PR02 numerical requirements, measurement/listening/resource approvals, actual annotations, holdout safeguards, live Logic and final product qualification remain pending
